tldr: Adjacent pairing has worst-case ATE risk \(2n^{-3}\) under difference in means, and the unrestricted minimax risk over the full bounded 1-Lipschitz class has the same leading term. A six-site observable correction proves \(D_n\ge1/(36n^4)\), while an embedded unrestricted bounded-outcome donor gives \(\limsup n^{10/3}D_n\le K_A\). Determining the first sharp term of \(D_n\)—its rate, coefficient, limiting state, matching all-Borel converse, and attaining original-record reconstruction—remains the sole novelty-bearing open objective. CausalSmith finite-saddle Theorem 2 is imported, still-to-prove substrate for the finite reduction, Borel lift, and posterior-variance interface.
